maria (partnerships): Heads-up: we're planning a breaking change to the Partner SDK auth headers and event hooks that will affect marketplace integrations and SI bundles. Need coordination across partners, cloud marketplace teams, and SIs.

maria (partnerships): TL;DR — SDK v2 -> v3 will change the auth header from `X-Redwood-Partner` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and remove legacy webhook handshake. Deprecation window: 90 days after announcement.

tom (eng-api): Thanks for the ping. Can we get a short compatibility matrix? Which endpoints change shape vs only header changes?

maria (partnerships): Good call. Quick breakdown:
- Generation/chat endpoints: header only (minor)
- Streaming protocol: minor framing changes (backwards-compatible for reads, not writes)
- Webhooks/event-handshake: incompatible (legacy handshake removed)
- SDK client helpers: name changes + new default retry policy

kelly (product): Q: Do cloud marketplaces need to re-bundle the SDK or just change config? I want to avoid re-cert cycles if possible.

samantha (eng-ml): For hardware partners with on-prem agents, the webhook handshake removal will require a small agent update. We can provide a patch that preserves old handshake for 60 days behind a feature flag to buy time.

maria (partnerships): @kelly marketplaces should be able to switch config for the header mapping (gateway-level) in most cases. Only marketplace packages that vend the Redwood SDK binary will need a republish.

oliver (sales): Heads-up: Enterprise customers with SI integrations will want a 6-month opt-in route. They'll push back on anything less.

maria (partnerships): We can't stretch the public deprecation longer than 90 days, but we can offer an Extended Compatibility Plugin (ECP) for enterprise customers on request. That plugin adds the legacy handshake translation layer.

tom (eng-api): Action items from infra side:
1) Add version negotiation header `X-Redwood-SDK-Version` to the API gateway (default v2 -> v3).
2) Add metric `partner_sdk_mismatch` to monitor failed calls.
3) Implement 403 error with code `unsupported_sdk_version` and clear migration docs.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. We'll need a release calendar for announcement, SDK release, marketplace notices, SI tech brief, and joint PR coordination. Proposed dates: announce 2025-10-10, SDK release 2025-10-24, deprecation enforcement 2026-01-22. Thoughts? :calendar:

kelly (product): Looks reasonable. Add a canary period for the marketplace bundles — two weeks after SDK publish to catch packaging issues.

samantha (eng-ml): We can ship the agent patch the same day as SDK release. We'll gate the legacy handshake behind `REDWOOD_LEGACY_HANDSHAKE=true` for 60 days; after that flag is ignored.

tom (eng-api): Example error payload we should return to partners to simplify their logs:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "unsupported_sdk_version",
  "message": "Your client is using SDK version v2 which is deprecated. See https://redwood.ai/partner-sdk/migrate for upgrade steps.",
  "recommended_action": "Upgrade to v3 or enable the Extended Compatibility Plugin"
}
```

maria (partnerships): Nice. We'll draft a migration guide and SDK changelog. Also need a one-pager for marketplace partners and a technical appendix for SIs.

oliver (sales): I'll start templated emails for our top 10 SIs and large marketplace customers. Can we get a short FAQ from eng by EOD Friday?

tom (eng-api): Yes — I'll produce a 1-page FAQ: compatibility matrix, error codes, migration checklist, and sample curl commands.

maria (partnerships): Coordination checklist (who owns what):
- Announcement copy + legal signoff: maria, kelly
- SDK release artifacts + changelog: tom, samantha
- Marketplace package notices: kelly, oliver
- SI technical brief + webinar: oliver, samantha
- Enterprise ECP requests + contract addenda: maria, sales ops

samantha (eng-ml): Also adding a quick migration snippet for SDK users to auto-detect header mode: 

```
if (process.env.REDWOOD_LEGACY_HANDSHAKE === 'true') {
  client.setHandshake('legacy')
} else {
  client.setHandshake('modern')
}
```

maria (partnerships): Can everyone reply with ETA for their tasks by EOD tomorrow? I'll consolidate into a partner coordination deck.

aj-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: partner-sdk-v3 -> staging at 2025-10-20T02:00Z.

kelly (product): ETA for announcement copy: EOD Thursday. Marketplace notice draft: Friday COB.

tom (eng-api): SDK release artifacts ready: 2025-10-24. FAQ by Friday EOD. Gateway header change deployed to staging: today.

samantha (eng-ml): Agent patch PR in review, can merge by Friday. Canary build available same day.

oliver (sales): SI email templates and webinar invite draft: Monday next week.

maria (partnerships): Great — I'll assemble the deck and scheduling doc. We'll want an internal dry-run with PMs, eng, legal, and sales next Tuesday. :thumbsup:

tom (eng-api): One more ask: add a compatibility test to the partner CI matrix that runs old and new handshake scenarios against staging gateway. That will catch regressions.

maria (partnerships): Noted. Adding to checklist. Thanks everyone — I'll post the first draft of the partner coordination deck in #partnerships tomorrow.

oliver (sales): Thanks — will loop in top SI contacts after the webinar date is locked.

maria (partnerships): Closing thread for now. Please update the doc when you have ETAs."
